instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
From the first images to what the find shows

Webb's Near-Infrared Camera records a run of (1) ........ long exposures, tracking a faint speck against the background of stars.
    ↓
The speck is accepted as a body circling Uranus, and the addition to the planet's moon family is announced in (2) ........ .
    ↓
With the newcomer counted in, the number of moons known to circle Uranus reaches (3) ........ .
    ↓
Its path proves to be almost circular and to lie in the gap between Bianca and (4) ........ , not far from the plane of the planet's equator.
    ↓
Because of its size, the object had gone unnoticed for the nearly (5) ........ between Voyager 2's flyby and Webb's images.
    ↓
The find is presented in the end as much a tribute to Voyager 2's legacy as a correction of its (6) ........ .

items.prompt: Webb's Near-Infrared Camera records a run of (1) ........ long exposures, tracking a faint speck against the background of stars.
items.evidence: On 2 February 2025, Webb's Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of ten long-exposure images, each lasting forty minutes, over a period of roughly six hours, tracking a faint point of light moving against the background of stars in a pattern consistent with an object orbiting Uranus itself.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of ten long-exposure images; the gap asks how many exposures the run contained, so the answer is 'ten'.

revision.onceki_prompt: The Near-Infrared Camera records ten long exposures, each of (1) ........ , while a faint speck is followed against the star background for roughly six hours.
revision.ne_degisti: Kutu hem poz sayisini ('ten') hem toplam sureyi ('roughly six hours') veriyordu; 6 saat / 10 = 36 ~ 40 dakika islemi cevabi pasaja hic bakmadan veriyordu. Sizinti burada esdizim degil aritmetikti; iki sayi da kutudan cikarildi ve akis semasinin baska bir yerinde tekrar edilmedi.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The Near-Infrared Camera records a run of long exposures, each of (1) ........ , as a faint speck is followed against the background of stars.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: On 2 February 2025, Webb's Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of ten long-exposure images, each lasting forty minutes, over a period of roughly six hours, tracking a faint point of light moving against the background of stars in a pattern consistent with an object orbiting Uranus itself.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk 'each of ___' esdizim obeginin ucuna aciliyordu: kok tek basina okununca istenen seyin bir sure oldugu belliydi ve poz suresi olarak 'forty minutes' anlam duzeyinde parcasiz uretilebiliyordu (E7 3/3 anlam, kelime duzeyi degil).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk ayni cumlede kalibin ucundan kaynagin sectigi sayima tasindi: sorulan sey artik pozun suresi degil, cekilen poz sayisi. Kutudan 'forty minutes' de cikarildi, boylece 5. kutudaki 'forty years' ile sozcuk yankisi kalmadi ve hicbir aritmetik kestirme kurulamiyor.

items.prompt: The speck is accepted as a body circling Uranus, and the addition to the planet's moon family is announced in (2) ........ .
items.evidence: In February 2025, astronomers added one more member to that family: a small moon so faint that no previous mission had ever recorded it, spotted only because a modern space telescope was powerful enough to catch its dim reflected light.
items.explanation: Paragraph A says that in February 2025 astronomers added one more member to Uranus's family of moons; so the answer is 'February 2025'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The speck is accepted as a body circling Uranus and is entered in the records under the provisional (2) ........ S/2025 U1.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The newly found body has been given the provisional designation S/2025 U1.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi yerlesik bir astronomi terimi: yeni bulunan gok cisimlerine kalici ad verilmeden once 'provisional designation' atanmasi adlandirma geleneginin kendisidir ve S/2025 U1 bicimindeki kod bu terimin isaretidir; model uc turda da 'designation' yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Kutudan 'provisional' sozcugunu kaldirmak yetmiyor, cunku sizdiran sey sifat degil adlandirma gelenegini bilmek. E6 onerisi: C paragrafinin gozlem ayrintisi - cismin kac pozda izlendigi ya da hangi tarihte kaydedildigi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski kutu C/1'e capaliydi ve cevap ('designation') adlandirma gelenegini bilmekten cikiyordu. Yeni kutu C/1'e hic degmiyor: kanit A/2'ye, duyurunun tarihine tasindi. Kutudan S/2025 U1 kodu da kaldirildi, cunku kod yilin kendisini tasiyordu; tarih artik yalniz A/2'den okunuyor.

items.prompt: With the newcomer counted in, the number of moons known to circle Uranus reaches (3) ........ .
items.evidence: With this addition, Uranus's known moon count rises to twenty-nine, and the new object becomes the fourteenth member of its group of small inner moons, a crowd that orbits far closer to the planet than its five largest and best-known satellites, Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania and Oberon.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says that with this addition Uranus's known moon count rises to twenty-nine; the fourteenth in the same sentence counts only the group of small inner moons, so the answer is 'twenty-nine'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Too faint to be measured directly, the object has its width put at about (3) ........ , which makes it one of the smallest moons known anywhere.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Because it has not been imaged in enough detail to measure directly, its size has to be estimated: assuming it reflects light in a similar way to Uranus's other small moons, astronomers calculate a diameter of about six miles, or ten kilometres, making it one of the smallest moons known anywhere in the solar system.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevap ('ten kilometres') dunya bilgisiyle uretilebiliyordu: kucuk bir ic uydunun capinin on kilometre mertebesinde olmasi gezegen bilimi genel kulturu; E7 uc turda da anlam duzeyinde dogru bildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit ayni pasajin baska bir cumlesine (E/1) kaydirildi ve hedef, calismanin kendi sectigi bir sayima cevrildi. Yaygin bilgi burada YANLIS secenege capali: Uranus'un uydu sayisi olarak genel kulturde 27 dolasiyor, metnin verdigi sayi ise 29. C/2'ye artik hicbir soru degmiyor.

items.prompt: Its path proves to be almost circular and to lie in the gap between Bianca and (4) ........ , not far from the plane of the planet's equator.
items.evidence: Its orbit lies roughly 35,000 miles, or 56,000 kilometres, from the centre of Uranus, in the gap between two previously known moons, Ophelia and Bianca.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the orbit lies in the gap between two previously known moons, Ophelia and Bianca; since Bianca is already given in the question, the answer is 'Ophelia'.

items.prompt: Because of its size, the object had gone unnoticed for the nearly (5) ........ between Voyager 2's flyby and Webb's images.
items.evidence: Its size simply placed it below the threshold that Voyager's instruments, or any Earth-based telescope in the decades since, could resolve, meaning the moon had been circling Uranus unnoticed for the nearly forty years between that flyby and Webb's observations.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the moon had been circling Uranus unnoticed for the nearly forty years between the flyby and Webb's observations, so the answer is 'forty years'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The moon is counted as the (5) ........ member of the planet's crowd of small inner satellites.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: With this addition, Uranus's known moon count rises to twenty-nine, and the new object becomes the fourteenth member of its group of small inner moons, a crowd that orbits far closer to the planet than its five largest and best-known satellites, Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania and Oberon.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Gerekce iki cevabin savunulabildigini soyluyordu: kanit cumlesi ayni anda iki sayi tasiyor (yirmi dokuz toplam uydu, on dorduncu ic uydu) ve kutu hangisinin istendigini yeterince ayirmiyordu; dogru sirayi tutturmak buyuk olcude sansa kaliyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Rakip sayi sorunu kokten kaldirildi: kutu artik iki sayili E/1 cumlesine degil, tek bir sureyi veren F/3'e capali. Rakip aday (1986'yi bilip 2025'ten cikaran adayin bulacagi 'thirty-nine years') metinde yok; pasaj 'nearly forty years' diyor, yani disaridan hesaplayan aday yanlis yazar.

items.prompt: The find is presented in the end as much a tribute to Voyager 2's legacy as a correction of its (6) ........ .
items.evidence: In that sense, the discovery is as much a tribute to Voyager 2's legacy as a correction of its limits: it is precisely because scientists have spent decades studying the images that spacecraft sent back that they know exactly where, and how carefully, to look with today's far more sensitive instruments.
items.explanation: Paragraph H says the discovery is as much a tribute to Voyager 2's legacy as a correction of its limits, so the answer is 'limits'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The team lead's comment: an object that slipped past even a (6) ........ shows how much of a well-studied planetary system can still lie hidden.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: As El Moutamid noted, the moon is small, but finding something that even a dedicated flyby mission missed underlines how much of even a well-studied planetary system can still remain hidden from view.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevap ('dedicated flyby mission') dunya bilgisiyle geliyordu: bir gezegenin uydularini yakindan goren seyin yakin gecis gorevi olmasi uzay haberlerinin standart bilgisi; E7 uc turda da anlam duzeyinde dogru bildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit ayni paragrafta bir sonraki cumleye (H/3) kaydirildi ve hedef gorev turunun adi olmaktan cikip metnin kendi degerlendirme sozcugune cevrildi. 'a correction of its ___' cercevesine disaridan bir tek aday gelmiyor (limitations, errors, blind spots hepsi olasi), yani kelime duzeyinde pasaj zorunlu.
